2610.10528.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
2610.10528.paper_summary: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.
2610.10528.paper_summary_zh: 即時機器人控制需要足夠的視覺歷史來推斷運動和任務進展，但處理這些歷史可能會延遲行動。<lb/>我們提出了Long-WAM，一個在即時控制限制下擴展因果世界-行動模型上下文的模型-系統框架。<lb/>我們的核心發現是，訪問歷史並不等同於使用它：當視頻基礎是自回歸（AR）預訓練時，較長的歷史帶來的收益更大。<lb/>我們首先從沒有行動標籤的機器人和自我中心視頻中學習因果預測，然後在世界-行動適應過程中保留這種歷史到未來的結構。<lb/>在RoboCasa GR-1上，將上下文從0.0秒增加到19.2秒，成功率從63.3%提高到78.7%，而雙向預訓練的初始化則沒有淨增益；機器人領域的AR預訓練進一步提高了GR-1和LIBERO-Long的峰值成功率。<lb/>在LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0和DOMINO中，Long-WAM也在比較方法中取得了最佳結果。<lb/>流式觀察編碼、異步執行和硬體特定加速使得在RTX 5090、DGX Spark和Jetson AGX Thor上部署成為可能，而不會丟失未來預測；在RTX 5090上，每個行動塊，包括未來視頻潛在預測，需時107.4毫秒。<lb/>在Unitree G1和YAM上的即時部署支持動態和長期操控，包括在動態杯堆疊中達到95%的成功率，而Pi0.5和Fast-WAM在20次試驗中均未成功。<lb/>作為一個記憶信息驅動的執行器，Long-WAM還補充了復合任務中的高層次規劃。
